neighbours.label: The delimiter that closes a source's name: the period or comma right after an abbreviated journal title in a reference-list citation ('Hum Mol Genet.', 'J Surg Oncol'), and likewise 'import'/'as' right after a module path in a Python import line. Tested on the citation case.
fire: Tanaka H, Mori Y. Early mobilisation after stroke. J Neurol Sci. 2011;305:20-25.
Okafor C, Wills D. Statin use and fracture risk. Am J Epidemiol. 2008;167:1-9.
Petrov A, Lind E. Gut flora in preterm infants. Acta Paediatr. 2015;104:440-446.
Novak R, et al. Airway remodelling in asthma. Eur Respir J. 2003;22:10-17.
Hughes P, Diaz L. Vitamin D and falls in the elderly. Clin Endocrinol. 2012;76:300-306.
Rossi G, Kim J. Imaging of knee cartilage. Br J Radiol. 2006;79:95-101.
Meyer T, Shah N. Renal outcomes in diabetes. Kidney Int. 2019;95:120-131.
Dubois F, Park H. Pain after dental surgery. J Oral Rehabil. 2010;37:55-62.
quiet: Tanaka and Mori studied early mobilisation after stroke and found that it helped.
Okafor and Wills asked whether statin use changes the risk of fracture.
Petrov and Lind described the gut flora of preterm infants in their first weeks.
Novak and colleagues wrote about airway remodelling in people with asthma.
Hughes and Diaz looked at vitamin D and falls in elderly patients.
Rossi and Kim compared ways of imaging knee cartilage, and they preferred the newer one.
Meyer and Shah followed renal outcomes in adults with diabetes for ten years.
Dubois and Park measured pain after dental surgery, but the sample was small.

notes: Probe: two reference-style citations 0.56 and 0.44 (peak on the '.' after the journal abbreviation); prose with a full journal name 0.09-0.13; import lines 0.30-0.41 (not tested here). Near misses keep authors and topic but are running prose with commas and periods.
